faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Mandi Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Mandi Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment is 20th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B. Tech./B.E./M.Sc. in Physics, Engineering Physics, Applied Physics, Photonics, or Chemical Sciences with 60% marks or 6.0 CGPA, along with a valid CSIR-UGC NET (JRF/LS), GATE, or INSPIRE Fellowship.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month, plus HRA if applicable.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview, document verification, and finally the preparation of a merit list.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Mandi is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q8. What are the desirable qualifications for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include experience in Quantum optics, photonics, Quantum Computing, and proficiency in programming languages like Python, Julia, MATLAB, or Mathematica.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with an M. Tech. or M.E. degree apply?
faq.answer: Yes, having an M. Tech. or M.E. degree is considered an additional desirable qualification for the Junior Research Fellow position.
